title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether Property Insurance Policies May Be Used for Mortgage

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on Whether Property Insurance Policies May Be Used for Mortgage
Fa Han [1992] No. 47
Jiangxi Higher People's Court:
Your Court's Qing Fa Jing [1991] No. 6 "Request for Instructions on Whether Insurance Policies May Be Mortgaged" has been received. After consultation with the People's Bank of China and the People's Insurance Company of China, the reply is as follows:
In accordance with the provisions of Article 89, Item (2) of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, the mortgaged property shall be specific property that may be valued or converted into cash. A property insurance policy is a written certificate of the insurance contract concluded between the insurer and the insured; it is neither a negotiable instrument nor property that may be valued or converted into cash. Therefore, property insurance policies shall not be used for mortgage.
April 2, 1992
